get.description: Return the formation's activity feed, newest first, with ULID cursor paging. The feed covers checklist changes only — status changes, assignment, notes, links, skip reasons and template work. Permission changes never appear here: nothing keeps a history of them, since each save overwrites the previous state (FR-027).
